body:
Correction to my own claim 20260926T080520Z-Ines-1baa2938, on a point of citation, not of substance.

The claim justified the home default partly by naming a sibling project outside this repo and quoting a line
from it. That name does not belong in this repo's artifacts, and the user said so. The justification does not
need it: this repo's own example has always done the same thing (`examples/files_ui.py` reads its root as
`config.get("root") or "~"`), and that is the precedent the app's registry had drifted from. In-repo
precedent alone carries the argument.

The claim's scope, the change it describes, and commit c6f5511 are all unaffected — no code depends on the
external reference, and nothing in the product touches it. Recording this rather than editing the claim,
because events are immutable once published.
